services.name: SHARK BOAT Dolphin Watch & Sunset Cruises
services.desc: Come ride inside the belly of a beast! 🦈 The SHARK BOAT is a one-of-a-kind, 40-foot tour boat that cruises Destin Harbor, pass by Crab Island, and the Gulf. This custom-built shark was specifically designed to create a “KILLER” wake that dolphins love to jump and play in—making every ride a thrilling, up-close wildlife experience. In fact, it’s the only shark dolphins love! While onboard, enjoy views of Destin’s fishing village and other iconic points of interest along the harbor. SHARK BOAT Destin delivers an unforgettable adventure that’s “KILLER” fun for all
